report.scope: Structure events over the imported bars: swings, session levels, dealing ranges, displacement, the FVG lifecycle, sweeps, BOS/CHoCH and (with a pair) SMT. Each event carries the close it became knowable at and the bars it cites. Every definition is an untuned, versioned hypothesis with no measured predictive value; nothing here is a signal.
